summary: Comprehensive implementation plan to expand the IGNOU Database, Admin Catalog Manager, and Storefront filters to support all 7 IGNOU Programme Categories (Bachelor Degree, Master Degree, Post Graduate Diploma, Diploma, Post Graduate Certificate, Certificate Degree, and Awareness / Appreciation) and pre-seed all 185 programmes (plus updated BASKH & BAUDH Honours courses) with their complete Compulsory, Optional, Practical, and Project courses.
